subject: LEAP-SECOND directive
notes: kb/Work PB1379 landed. The floor ('greater than or equal to zero') was lost on the float and SDIDI carriers of FORMATTED-TIME, FORMATTED-DATETIME and LOCALE-TIME-FROM-SECONDS because the landing truncated a tiny negative to 0 before the screen; the landing now rounds toward negative infinity (CobolDate.SecondsOfReal / SecondsOfDec), so a COMP-2 -1.0E-10 takes the EC-ARGUMENT-FUNCTION path under ON. The ceiling (86,401) and the fixed-point carriers were already right. LOCALE-TIME-FROM-SECONDS(86400) under ON now presents the leap second as 23:59:60 through the one CobolDate.TimeOfDay reading (15.54.4 r2), where it said 24:00:00.
